dish: Tsuruhashi yakiniku with tsukedare dipping sauce (100 g single portions)
address: 3-3 Shimoajiharachō, Tennōji-ku, Osaka (by JR Tsuruhashi Stn)
w: Founded 1948. Mapple's Tsuruhashi yakiniku guide calls it the district's oldest yakiniku house and credits it with the tsukedare dipping-sauce style. Rurubu also lists it, and both note its 100 g single portions. Address per Mapple; an earlier lead gave 2-13 Shimoajiharachō, so recheck when pinning.

dish: Kuroge wagyu yakiniku cut to a different thickness for each cut
n: Yakiniku Yoshida Shinkan (焼肉 吉田 新館)
address: 3-15 Higashiuemachi, Tennōji-ku, Osaka (5 min from JR Tsuruhashi central exit)
w: A four-floor Tsuruhashi yakiniku house. Both Rurubu and Mapple list it for its hand-selected domestic kuroge wagyu, with each cut trimmed to its own thickness.

dish: Denki Bran and a rotating list of ~20 rare sake with creative small plates
n: Taishō Salon Hige to Bōin (大正サロン 髭とボヰン)
address: Taishō-ku, Osaka (about 50 m from Taishō Stn)
w: A standing bar by Taishō Station, picked in Osaka Metro's senbero feature and selected for the Tabelog Tachinomi Hyakumeiten 2025.
A Bib Gourmand in the MICHELIN Guide Japan 2026, a neighbourhood sushi counter in Nishikujō on the way to USJ.

address: Minato-ku, Osaka (8 min walk from JR Bentenchō Stn)
w: A shokudō founded in 1945 and known for huge portions, with queues at lunch. Osaka Metro's Osaka Mania calls it 'the face of Bentenchō', and the Minato ward office featured it in a ward publication.
